tess: Quick sync — we still have inconsistent behavior for quota vs concurrency when routing falls back. Console badges and client retry logic are getting messy. Any concrete proposals?

samir: Short take: 429 should mean rate/quota, 409 should mean resource conflict. But fallback routing currently sometimes returns 200 + `fallback:true` which is confusing. :grimacing:

maria: From product POV users want a stable, actionable contract. Suggest we add a top-level `error.type` and `error.hint` in the body and keep HTTP codes semantically aligned. Returning 200 for fallback is a no-go.

raj: Console note: we map badges based on HTTP status + a few headers. If we standardize a header like `x-rw-error-type: fallback|quota|concurrency` + `x-rw-retry-after`, dashboard mapping will be trivial.

ellie: Telemetry: ingestion only looks at status_code today. If we add `x-rw-error-type` we should tag events with `error_type` and `error_variant` so alerts and regressions can target the right signal.

samir: Implementation detail: runtime returns internal codes like `ERR_CONCURRENCY_EXCEEDED` which we currently map to 409. I can change mapping to 429 for concurrency and emit `x-rw-error-type:concurrency`, but that will change client-visible status codes.

maria: @samir SDKs must be updated to surface `error.type` and map it to typed exceptions. Otherwise product integrations might mis-handle errors.

tess: Proposed plan: 1) Stop returning 200 for fallback. 2) Remap concurrency -> 429, keep quota -> 429 but differentiate via header `x-rw-error-type`. 3) Add `error.type` + `error.hint` to response body. 4) Dual-write legacy header for 72h for compatibility. Rollout: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 3 days behind feature flag. SDK patch release to read header. Comments?

raj: Console timeline: 2 days to update mapping and tooltip copy. We'll show retroactive labels for any events that include `error_type` header (past 24h).

ellie: I'll update ingestion rules and alerting. Also propose a new metric `fallback_count` and `error_type:concurrency` gauge so SREs can create burn-rate alerts.

samir: One concern — some customers rely on 409 semantic today. To be safe I propose we include both `x-rw-error-type` and a `x-rw-legacy-code: 409` header for 30–72h while we notify customers. That buys safety.

tess: OK — agree on dual-write for 72h then flip. Action items: @samir runtime PR + dual-write, @ellie telemetry ingestion update + new metrics, @raj console mapping + copy + retro labels, @maria SDK patch note + docs snippet. I'll add rollback steps to the runbook.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary release started for `error-mapping-v2` to 5% at 2026-03-20T15:04Z :rocket:

maria: Also add a short example in the API docs showing client-side handling (check `x-rw-error-type`, then look at `Retry-After` / `error.hint`).

raj: :thumbsup: I'll draft the tooltip copy and escalate for UX review.

tess: Thanks all — I'll schedule a 15-min sync after the first canary checkpoint to confirm telemetry looks clean and we haven't regressed dashboards.
